name: consult_knowledge
description: Ask the knowledge specialist a factual question (system types, blackouts, subsidy, cost, inspection, cancellation). Returns a grounded answer proposal and source IDs.

name: consult_qualification
description: Ask the qualification specialist which lead details the caller has given so far and which are still missing.

name: request_crm_plan
description: Ask the CRM planner to prepare ONE record change: a new enquiry, an update, a callback request, a human handoff or an opt-out. Returns a plan_id, the exact proposed change and anything still missing. Nothing is saved yet.

name: execute_crm_plan
description: Execute a prepared plan by its plan_id. Only after the caller has confirmed it (opt-outs need no extra confirmation). Each plan runs at most once.

name: verify_identity
description: Verify an existing customer by contact ID and email. Required before any change to an existing record, callback, handoff or opt-out.

name: find_lead
description: Check whether an enquiry already exists for an email. Required before create_lead. Does not reveal record details.

name: check_availability
description: Check a 30-minute callback slot (ISO time, Asia/Kolkata). Required before schedule_callback.
